description: Request a Typeform background image at the default, tablet, mobile, or thumbnail size. The tool expects a JSON response with image metadata rather than returning image bytes.

image_id.description: Unique identifier for the image resource
image_id.title: Image Id

size.description: Dimension preset for the background image. default: scaled to fit 1680x1050px, tablet: scaled to fit 1024x768px, mobile: scaled to fit 460x320px, thumbnail: scaled to fit 80x50px
size.title: Size

name: get_background_by_size

avg_color.description: Average color of the image in hex format
avg_color.title: Avg Color

has_alpha.description: Whether the image has an alpha channel for transparency
has_alpha.title: Has Alpha

height.description: Height of the background image in pixels
height.title: Height

media_type.description: Media type of the image (image/gif, image/jpeg, or image/png)
media_type.title: Media Type

width.description: Width of the background image in pixels
width.title: Width
